issue: Can a defendant obtain appellate review of a suppression argument not raised in the district court, without showing good cause under Federal Rule of Criminal Procedure 12(c)(3)?

sides.position: Defendants may still obtain review of unpreserved suppression arguments under Rule 12 (the excerpt cuts off before stating this side's full rule).
Unpreserved suppression arguments are unreviewable absent a showing of good cause under Rule 12(c)(3).
